# Customize agent workflows

Inspect `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, skills, prompts, and project docs.
Keep skills self-contained, task-specific, and free from references to absent
`_bmad` scripts or framework files. Avoid duplicating large instructions across
skills; link to a sibling skill for specialized work. Validate front matter and
paths after changes.
